一句话作用: NGS analysis toolkit. BAM to bigWig conversion, QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprints), heatmaps/profiles (TSS, peaks), for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq visualization.
关键输入: Before running any analysis, validate BAM, bigWig, and BED files using the validation script: This checks file existence, BAM indices, and format correctness.
关键输出: Always validate files first using scripts/validate files.py to check: - File existence and readability - BAM indices present (.bai files) - BED format correctness - File sizes reasonable
